# Food & Wine Classic in Aspen

> > Premier culinary event bringing together acclaimed chefs, winemakers, and food enthusiasts in Aspen for immersive tastings, demonstrations, and celebrations.

The Food & Wine Classic in Aspen is an annual multi-day festival featuring the Best New Chefs, Grand Tasting Pavilion experiences, exclusive events like the Top of the Mountain Party, and partnerships with American Express Premium Events Collection. The event offers various pass options for both consumers and trade professionals to access culinary demonstrations, wine tastings, and networking opportunities.
